wins.text: Record full-year total net inflows of $641 billion, including $281 billion in Q4 alone — two consecutive record flow quarters in H2 2024
Full-year revenue of $20.4 billion, up 14% YoY; operating income of $8.1 billion, up 23%; EPS of $43.61, up 15%
Full-year as-adjusted operating margin of 44.5%, up 280 bps YoY; Q4 margin of 45.5%, up 390 bps YoY

Industry-leading ETF net inflows of $390 billion in 2024, including $41 billion into digital asset ETPs launched in 2024; Bitcoin ETP grew to over $50 billion AUM in under a year — largest ETF launch in history
Aladdin ACV grew 12% YoY (13% on constant currency basis); full-year technology services revenue of $1.6 billion, up 8%; signed some of the largest clients ever in 2024

risks.text: HPS acquisition expected to close mid-2025, pending regulatory approvals, creating integration execution risk and near-term earnings dilution from ~2,300 new employees and higher G&A
Higher share count (6.9 million shares issued at GIP closing) and lower nonoperating income partially offset Q4 EPS growth; co-investment valuation losses of $7 million in nonoperating results
Steepening yield curve and 'higher for longer' rate environment creates uncertainty around timing of $10 trillion money market fund rotation into longer-duration fixed income and other asset classes
Regulatory and safe harbor reform required before private markets can meaningfully enter U.S. DC/401(k) retirement channel — management explicitly flagged this as a prerequisite
Core G&A expense expected to grow mid- to high single digits in 2025 (excluding HPS), driven by GIP/Preqin consolidation and continued technology investment, pressuring near-term margins

guidance_items.detail: Targeting $1.5 billion in share repurchases in 2025, up from $1.6 billion full-year 2024 but with explicit forward commitment; Board approval expected for Q1 2025 dividend increase

Pro forma for HPS and Preqin, private markets and technology expected to exceed 20% of total revenue; private markets platform expected to reach $600 billion AUM and $3+ billion in revenues (~15% of 2024 revenues)
Organic base fee growth target reaffirmed at 5% or better through-the-cycle; Q4 2024 exit rate of 7% annualized provides strong momentum into 2025; GIP, HPS, Preqin expected to lift above 5% target
Aladdin ACV growth target reaffirmed at low-to-mid teens over the long term; Q4 2024 ACV growth of 12% YoY

2025 core G&A expense (excluding HPS) expected to grow mid- to high single digits, primarily from GIP/Preqin consolidation and technology investment; headcount to increase by ~2,300 with Preqin and HPS additions
2025 tax rate estimated at approximately 25% (vs. ~21% Q4 2024 which benefited from discrete items)

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Specific outlook for fixed income flows and investor positioning entering 2025 given yield curve steepening
Regulatory safe harbor reform requirements as a prerequisite for private markets entering 401(k)/DC retirement channel
Margin trajectory and expense puts-and-takes for 2025 including HPS integration costs
